first.text: VO: I throw two ten-pound notes onto the table.
VO: Carstairs collects together all the cards, and riffles them before dealing the first two cards.
CARSTAIRS: First card is an Eight in Clubs.
CARSTAIRS: And the dealer... gets the Two of Diamonds.
CARSTAIRS: You can fold, or make a bet to stay in.
V: Pass.
VO: Carstairs takes the stake and gathers up the cards.
V: ... three hundred and eighty pounds left ...
CARSTAIRS: Keep going?
V: Hit me.
V: Twenty pounds.
CARSTAIRS: The pot stands at twenty pounds.
VO: Carstairs deals out my first card face up .
CARSTAIRS: The lady has the Seven of Hearts.
CARSTAIRS: And it's a Four in Diamonds for me.
V: Fold.
VO: Carstairs collects the pot and gathers up the cards.
V: ... I'm down to three hundred and sixty pounds ...
CARSTAIRS: Have you had enough?
V: Let's try again.
VO: I toss in my ante.
VO: Carstairs spins me a new card from the deck.
CARSTAIRS: The lady gets a Nine in Clubs.
CARSTAIRS: And I have the Queen of Spades.
V: Pass.
VO: Carstairs scoops up the money from the table and gathers up the cards.
V: ... three hundred and forty pounds left ...
CARSTAIRS: Again?
V: Another!
VO: Carstairs passes me an opening card from the top of the deck.
CARSTAIRS: the Nine of Hearts.
CARSTAIRS: Dealer has the Jack of Diamonds.
V: Fold.
VO: Carstairs takes the money and gathers up the cards.
V: ... I'm down to three hundred and twenty pounds ...
CARSTAIRS: Again?
V: Deal.
VO: Carstairs tosses over my first card face up .
CARSTAIRS: The lady receives the Two of Hearts.

CARSTAIRS: Keep going?
V: Deal.
VO: Carstairs tosses over my first card face up .
CARSTAIRS: First out is the Five of Clubs.
CARSTAIRS: And it's the Jack of Hearts for me.
V: Fold.
VO: Carstairs takes the money off the table and gathers up the cards.

V: I'll play a little more.

CARSTAIRS: And it's a Five in Spades for me.
V: Pass.
VO: Carstairs collects the stake and gathers up the cards.
V: ... eighty pounds left ...
CARSTAIRS: Keep going?
V: I'd better be lucky this time!
VO: Carstairs spins me a new card from the deck.
CARSTAIRS: First out is a Nine in Diamonds.
CARSTAIRS: And I have an Eight in Spades.
V: Pass.
VO: Carstairs takes the pot and gathers up the cards.
V: ... sixty pounds left ...
CARSTAIRS: Again?
VO: Carstairs tosses over my first card face up .
CARSTAIRS: The lady receives the Four of Hearts.
CARSTAIRS: And it's the Seven of Spades for me.
V: Fold.
VO: Carstairs collects the money off the table and gathers up the cards.
V: You've cleaned me out!
CARSTAIRS: I'm sorry to hear that, Mrs V.
CARSTAIRS: Thanks for the game.
VO: He tucks his winnings into his waistcoat pocket and grins like an idiot.
